Living room furniture work

Your five items, specified so the carpenter and fabricator can quote against the same thing. Sizes are from the model. Confirm each on site.

1Safety door with panelling and grill

Size
To suit the main door frame, about 3′2″ × 7′
Frame
Steel, powder-coated teak brown
Lower part
Solid panel to 2′7″, teak laminate with two brass strips
Upper part
Brass-finish grill in the kolam lattice used on the TV wall, stainless mosquito mesh behind
Hardware
Multi-point lock, door viewer, brass pull handle
Panelling
Teak laminate on the lobby wall around the frame, up to the ceiling, brass nameplate above the door

Check: it opens outward into the common lobby. Make sure the open door does not block a neighbour's door, the lift or the stairs, and hinge it away from the shoe cabinet. Get the society's okay for the panelling.

2Mandir

Position
North-east corner of the living room, wall-mounted
Size
About 15″ wide × 16″ deep, from 2′7″ to 7′ including the gopuram top
Body
Teak laminate, kumkum-red back panel with a gold kolam
Storage
One drawer below for puja items
Details
Brass bells, brass kalash on top, warm LED strip hidden inside the top

Check: line the lamp area with a steel tray or tile. Laminate scorches under a diya.

3Shoe rack

Position
Outside the flat, against the lobby wall next to the door
Size
4′ wide × 1′ deep × 3′2″ high on a 3″ plinth
Build
Closed, tilt-out shutters, teak laminate, brass handles, ventilation slots
Holds
About 16–20 pairs

Check: lobby space is common area. Get written permission before it goes in.

4Main door laminate replacement

Inside face
Teak laminate matching the TV unit
Outside face
Teak laminate, two brass strips and brass studs
Edges
Matching edge banding on all four edges
Hardware
Brass pull handle, floor door stopper
Hinge
On the side with the 7″ of wall, so the door folds back flat

Check: if the existing door is hollow or warped, re-laminating will not fix it. Ask the carpenter to tap it before quoting.

5TV unit with panelling and kolam

Back panel
4′5″ wide between the pillars, from 2′2″ to 8′5″. 18 mm ply, teak laminate
Kolam
CNC-cut kolam band above the TV, about 4′3″ × 2′5″, gold inlay on teak
Unit
Floating box 4′5″ × 1′4″ deep × 1′2″ high, fixed 1′ above the floor
Storage
Four handle-less push-to-open drawers with shadow gaps, centre flap in fluted glass for the set-top box
Lighting
Warm LED strip under the unit
Wiring
Concealed conduit behind the panel for TV, set-top box and internet

Check: the clear width between the pillars is about 4′6″. A 55″ TV fits. A 65″ TV does not.

Ceiling kolam for the painter

Kavi red loops and turmeric dots on a lime-white ceiling, the colours of a festival kolam. Show this sheet to the painter. It has the colours, sizes and the order to paint in.

Sizes are from the builder's plan. Windows in the living room and both bedrooms face east.

Living room

10'6" × 18'6"

  • Wall mandir in the north-east corner with a kolam backdrop
  • Ceiling kolam in kavi red with turmeric dots on lime-white, warm hidden lighting
  • Red-oxide (kavi) band on the lower walls with a white kolam border
  • Athangudi-tile pattern rug in kavi red, turmeric and indigo
  • Turmeric cotton curtains with a maroon border on a brass rod
  • Brass uruli with floating flowers on the coffee table
  • 6 ft teak-frame sofa, kalamkari canvas above it

Notes for the carpenter

  • Office door opens into the office. The two doors are less than a foot apart.
  • Wardrobe shutters are hinged, not sliding, so the pull-outs can open fully.
  • Ironing board in the wardrobe must be a swivel type. A straight pull-out hits the bed.
  • Kitchen upper cabinets start about 7 ft from the floor.
  • Hinge the kitchen door on the counter side, so it does not swing into the crockery cabinet.
  • Anchor the jhoola hooks into the RCC slab with chemical anchors rated for at least 250 kg. Have a structural fixer do it, not the carpenter.
  • Leave about 3 ft clear in front of and behind the jhoola, and fit a chain lock so it can be held still.
  • Get the society's written OK before placing the shoe cabinet in the lobby. Keep it under 1 ft deep and closed.
  • Fix the Venkateswara frame with concealed brackets into the wall, not a single nail. A 3′ × 4½′ frame with glass is heavy.
  • Fridge space is about 27 inches wide. Measure before buying.
  • Use branded soft-close drawer channels. Saree trays are heavy.
  • Fit safety grills on all large windows before moving in.
  • Check the flower bed's waterproofing and drain outlet before placing pots. Keep pots inside the bed, never on the parapet.
  • Fix the TV unit and wardrobes to the wall so they cannot tip.
